label: Daum search ads (now Kakao 키워드광고)
terms_note: Kakao Developers app converted to a 비즈 앱 with business verification and the Keyword Ad permission; business token; 프리미엄링크 campaigns only (톡채널광고 report API only). Free.

discovery.auth: oauth2 business token (Kakao Developers biz app with 비즈니스 인증 + Keyword Ad permission)

auth: 1. Kakao Developers app → 비즈 앱 → 비즈니스 인증 → request the Keyword Ad permission.
2. Business token (OAuth) with the required consents.
3. Premium Link campaigns only; TalkChannel ads report-only.

fields.name: business_token
fields.help: Kakao business token (비즈니스 토큰) issued by POST https://kauth.kakao.com/oauth/business/token after the advertiser consents to the keyword_management scope in your biz app (https://developers.kakao.com/docs/latest/ko/business-auth/rest-api). It has no refresh flow; it expires after long non-use.

config_fields.name: ad_account_id
config_fields.help: Kakao keyword ad account id (numeric, without the K prefix), sent as the `adAccountId` header that every campaign and report call requires.

me.note: GET https://kapi.kakao.com/v1/business/tokeninfo: validates the business token ({id, token_user_id, biz_agreements [{group, scope, ad_account_ids}], status}).

list_accounts.note: GET /openapi/v1/adAccounts/pages (page is 0-based upstream): keyword ad accounts (ON and OFF) with raw.memberType and raw.config. Amounts are KRW.

list_campaigns.note: GET /openapi/v1/campaigns for the account in the ad_account_id config (adAccountId header; account_id is not sent). `status` filters config: ON, OFF or DEL. `budget` is the daily budget in KRW (null when unset); raw.status lists the serving states. No paging.

get_report.note: GET /openapi/v1/campaigns/report?metricsGroups=BASIC&start=&end= for every campaign of the configured account (campaign_id is not a filter here). Kakao expects dates as yyyyMMdd: pass date_from/date_to like 20260901 (up to two years back). spend is KRW.

update_budget.note: PATCH /openapi/v1/campaigns/{id}/dailyBudget {dailyBudgetAmount}: a whole number of KRW (`currency` is ignored); spends money. The campaign must belong to the configured ad account.

pause_resume.note: PATCH /openapi/v1/campaigns/{id}/onOff {id, config: OFF|ON} (only campaigns currently ON or OFF). Resuming restarts spending. Kakao answers an empty 200.

evidence: host api.keywordad.kakao.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.2 (DigiCert Inc)
probe: 6/6 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route answered 401 too, so the host authenticates before routing
HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 6/6 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; every parameter and body key named on the page
